description.text: mental associations generated by knowledge and past experience.

definitions.text: the collective understanding by a nation's people of the features presumed to be central and relatively permanent, and that distinguish the nation from other nations.
the characteristics of a nation that its people perceive to be central, distinctive, and enduring (CED) in a nation when past, present and future is taken into account.
the essentially irrational psychological bond that binds fellow nationals together and which is supposed to constitute the essence of national identity.

description.text: This psychological bond is usually termed "a sense of belonging" and such expressions point to the close link established between each individual and the collective self, namely the nation

papers.title: BRANDING THE NATION: TOWARDS A BETTER UNDERSTANDING

description.text: fake news outlets lack the news media's editorial norms and processes for ensuring the accuracy and credibility of information
It is particularly pernicious in that it undermines the credibility of standard news outlets
